alternatives_rejected.why: Injected delay would not change disk I/O. currencyservice_diskio is the strongest deviation in the system (E1, E3), far above latency or socket (z=9.79, E3). The flat own self-time with slower inbound calls (E2) also fits requests queuing behind disk contention before the handler runs. Caveat: the huge disk I/O z-score probably reflects a near-constant baseline, and the E2 pattern also fits network delay, so this call is the less certain part.
frontend latency-50 rose 196.5% (E1), far less than currencyservice's 858.7%, so it is consistent with an upstream symptom rather than the source.
checkoutservice latency-90 rose only 90.8% (E1), and callers see currencyservice inbound latency up 7.71x (E2), so checkout's slowdown traces back to currencyservice.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the process causing heavy disk I/O in the currencyservice pod; if it can't be identified, reschedule the pod to a healthy node. Then confirm currencyservice disk I/O and inbound p50 latency return to baseline.
